description: Every asset Ghost Game needs, with generation-ready prompts. Source of truth for the asset pipeline (docs/ASSETS.md). Run `npm run assets` for a status report.
styleGuide: Stylized cartoon 3D game art for 'Ghost Game', a cute-spooky Halloween party game inspired by Google's Great Ghoul Duel doodle. Chunky, rounded, toy-like shapes with soft matte vinyl/clay materials, big expressive eyes, exaggerated proportions (big head, small body), friendly and goofy, never gory or scary. Night-time palette of deep indigo and violet with glowing accents. Faction colors: Ghosts spectral cyan #67e8f9, Zombies toxic lime #a3e635, Skeletons bone gold #fcd34d, Demons hellfire coral-red #f87171; neutral spirits violet #b48cff. Clean readable silhouettes, soft rim light, Pixar / Fall Guys / Fortnite level of charm and polish.
